Welcome to the 9th edition of Weekly Tidbits by Markets by Zerodha, where we bring you interesting stories that may not make it to a full Daily Brief but still deserve a closer look.
In this edition, we cover 12 stories across Global, Economy, Industry and Company (GEIC), from Bayer’s latest Roundup lawsuit victory and a potential AI infrastructure deal to SEBI’s new mutual fund rules and India’s push to expand domestic manufacturing.
